paragraphs: Shimon Kamtarya asked R' Hiyya bar Ba: Jerusalem Ha-Ro'eh, mishnah 3, “Someone such as I, a donkey driver who goes up to Jerusalem every year—must I rend?” Sedeh Yehoshua explains that he made chests: the Targum of meltahah, and in Ohalot, “a kamtra cover.” And R' Huna, in R' Shmuel bar Nahman's name: there.
